environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or application-layer filtering. The Flask app binds directly to port 8080. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db contains production user records including api_key and password_hash columns.
